# Volts & VINs (https://voltsandvins.com)

> Volts & VINs is a public used-Tesla marketplace and VIN-level price benchmark index covering 15,097 active used Tesla listings across the United States (1,168 priced $500+ below mileage-adjusted peer asking benchmarks).

## Key Marketplace Facts
- **Published VIN-Verified Catalog**: 15,097 used Tesla vehicles (Model Y, Model 3, Model S, Model X, Cybertruck)
- **Peer-Benchmarked Price Finds**: 1,168 listings priced `$500+` below mileage-adjusted peer asking prices (minimum 5 comparable peers in the same model, year, trim, drivetrain, and mileage band)
- **VIN-Decoded Specifications**: Every listing includes 17-character ISO 3779 VIN validation, VIN-derived build factory (Austin vs. Fremont), drivetrain (AWD vs. RWD), mileage, and location
- **Purchase & Reservation Model**: Online deal builder with ZIP delivery distance estimation; `$250` refundable reservation deposit after licensed selling dealer confirmation and written hold (`dealer_fulfillment`)
